No export scaling.", "simplification": "Meaning-specific reconstruction with original 1.4 mm strokes and freshly sampled 1.2 mm Index dots. All ten source cloud comparison cards remain in their original two-column/five-row order, with individual form glyphs, three ordinal height ticks, one extent span and one usual-role marker per card. Card widths differ in the top two rows to retain all eight cirrocumulus grains and all six altocumulus rolls. Three cirrus wisps, three altostratus fibres, one cirrostratus fibre and three nimbostratus precipitation lines remain. Fine forms are independently re-laid out; legend tick/marker lines and rain strokes remain at least 13 mm. Height marks are taught relative conventions, not measured altitude, weather forecast or autonomous cloud recognition. Original unfilled line roles are retained, including the 2.2 mm ViewPlus extent spans and 1.4 mm other lines. Extent-span lengths are at least 12.7 mm.", "canvas_mm": [170, 200]}, "teaching": "All ten source cloud comparison cards remain in their original two-column/five-row order, with individual form glyphs, three ordinal height ticks, one extent span and one usual-role marker per card. Card widths differ in the top two rows to retain all eight cirrocumulus grains and all six altocumulus rolls. Three cirrus wisps, three altostratus fibres, one cirrostratus fibre and three nimbostratus precipitation lines remain. Fine forms are independently re-laid out; legend tick/marker lines and rain strokes remain at least 13 mm. Height marks are taught relative conventions, not measured altitude, weather forecast or autonomous cloud recognition. Original unfilled line roles are retained, including the 2.2 mm ViewPlus extent spans and 1.4 mm other lines. Extent-span lengths are at least 12.7 mm. External object-name and viewpoint key required; physical tactile and learner evaluation remain pending. External accessible title and explanation are required; no lettering is embedded.", "nominal_checks": {"line_width_mm": 1.4, "index_dot_diameter_mm": 1.2, "index_coordinate_lattice_mm": 0.05,
